#load packages 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
```

```{r}
# Set the correct current aquaculture area
current_aquaculture_area <- 25.88  # km2
```


```{r}
# upload data to further Calculate the fold change
df <- read.csv(here("output_data/Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected/constraint_impact_analysis/constraint_impact_on_analogues.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    Decade_num = as.numeric(substr(Decade, 1, 4)),
    Fold_Change = (Climate_Suitable_km2 - Constraint_Area_km2) / current_aquaculture_area
  )

# Create the visualization
ggplot(df, aes(x = Decade_num, y = Fold_Change, color = Marine_Zone)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Pattern), size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~SSP, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Potential Expansion of Aquaculture Area",
    subtitle = "Available area as multiple of current aquaculture extent (25.88 km²)",
    x = "Decade",
    y = "Times larger than current area",
    color = "Marine Zone",
    linetype = "Pattern"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2020, 2090, by = 10)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2")

# Calculate summary statistics
summary_stats <- df %>%
  group_by(SSP, Marine_Zone, Pattern) %>%
  summarize(
    Max_Fold = max(Fold_Change),
    Min_Fold = min(Fold_Change),
    Mean_Fold = mean(Fold_Change),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(SSP, Marine_Zone, Pattern)

# Print rounded summary statistics
print(summary_stats %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 1)))

# Calculate the range of expansion potential
range_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(Marine_Zone) %>%
  summarize(
    Min_Expansion = min(Fold_Change),
    Max_Expansion = max(Fold_Change),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 1))

print("Range of potential expansion by marine zone:")
print(range_summary)
```

```{r}

# Prepare data and then calculate the fold change
df <- read.csv(here("output_data/Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024/constraint_impact_analysis/constraint_impact_on_analogues.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    Decade_num = as.numeric(substr(Decade, 1, 4)),
    Fold_Change = (Climate_Suitable_km2 - Constraint_Area_km2) / current_aquaculture_area
  )

# Set specific colors from viridis palette
zone_colors <- c(
  "Commonwealth Waters" = "#440154FF",  # deep purple from viridis
  "Coastal waters and territorial seas (state waters)" = "#21908CFF",  # teal
  "High Seas" = "#FDE725FF"  # yellow
)

# Commonwealth waters plot
p1 <- ggplot(df %>% filter(Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters"), 
       aes(x = Decade_num, y = Fold_Change, color = Marine_Zone)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Pattern), size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~SSP) +
  scale_color_manual(values = zone_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Commonwealth Waters",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Times larger than current area"
  )

# State waters and High seas plot
p2 <- ggplot(df %>% filter(Marine_Zone != "Commonwealth Waters"), 
       aes(x = Decade_num, y = Fold_Change, color = Marine_Zone)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Pattern), size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~SSP) +
  scale_color_manual(values = zone_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "State Waters and High Seas",
    x = "Decade",
    y = "Times larger than current area"
  )

# Combine plots vertically
combined_plot <- p1 / p2 +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Potential Expansion of Aquaculture Area",
    subtitle = "Available area as multiple of current aquaculture extent (25.88 km²)"
  )

# Save the plot with correct path
ggsave(
  filename = here("Figures", "aquaculture_expansion_detailed.png"),
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 12, 
  height = 10, 
  dpi = 300
)

```
